facts.name: Knowledge base search
facts.described_as: Search the platform's general-knowledge library (standards, codes, guidance and training material) -- not the project's own documents. Results are cited as general knowledge.

hints.purpose: Finds passages in the platform's general-knowledge library (standards, codes, guidance), not in this project's documents. One call searches every configured library and returns the best top_k passages by score (default 5, at most 20), each marked as general knowledge. With no library configured it returns an error that says so, not an empty search.

not_to_be_confused_with.difference: That one searches this project's own documents; an answer about the project must cite those, not the library.

question_kinds.how: A question about this project's documents is answered from them; the library only explains a general term or a standard.
The library holds no row of this project's bill.
The library holds neither this project's specification nor its bill.
The library holds neither this project's specification nor its drawings.
